question: Which of the following metals is present in nature in its free state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Platinum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Platinum is a heavy, malleable, ductile, highly unreactive, precious, gray-white transition metal.
 
• It is one of the rarest elements in the Earth's crust.
 
• Unlike many other metals,** platinum is often found in its native or free state**, meaning not combined with any other element.
 
• Platinum is often found in alluvial deposits in the form of grains, nuggets, or flakes.
 
• The extraction of platinum is a complex process because of its native state and requires complex methods to separate it from other materials.
 
• Platinum is used in catalytic converters, laboratory equipment, electrical contacts and electrodes, platinum resistance thermometers, dentistry equipment, and jewelry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnesium**

 
 
• Magnesium does not occur naturally in its free state because it reacts with the oxygen in the air to form magnesium oxide.
 
• It is the eighth most abundant element in the Earth's crust, and the third most plentiful element dissolved in seawater.
 
• Magnesium is used in dietary supplements, as an additive agent in conventional propellants, as a reducing agent for the production of uranium and other metals from their salts, and to produce magnesium carbonate for the ceramic industry
 
 
 
• **Calcium**
 
 
• Calcium does not occur in nature in its free state due to its chemical reactivity.
 
• It rapidly forms a gray-white oxide and nitride coating when exposed to air.
 
• Calcium is the fifth most abundant element in the Earth's crust.
 
• Its most common use is as a calcium supplement, in construction, for making cement and plaster, and in the manufacturing of cheese, where it helps form the curd.
 
 
 
• **Zinc**
 
 
• Zinc is not found in its pure, metallic form in nature. It is found in minerals.
 
• Zinc is the 24th most abundant element in Earth's crust.
 
• Zinc is used to galvanize other metals, such as iron and steel, to prevent rusting.
 
• It is also used in alloys such as brass and bronze, in die-casting, and in chemical applications.
